Enums
Every fixed list of values, such as error codes and response types.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

error-codes     Error Codes: Stable, append-only machine-readable error codes on the --json error envelope
                (envelope.code). Codes never change or get removed; branch on these, not on prose.
response-types  Response Types: The `type` discriminant present on every --json success envelope. Consumers switch on it
                to narrow `data`.

Open one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/api/enums/<name>
